mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_refresh_tokens (user_id, user_uid, token_hash, issued_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{userUid}, #{tokenHash}, #{issuedAt}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, user_uid, token_hash, issued_at, expires_at, revoked_at, metadata FROM auth_refresh_tokens WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > #{now} LIMIT 1
